entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, connect me to someone who can actually do something! This is unbelievable.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Your VeloBand Pulse is a piece of garbage! It doesn't track my heart rate correctly, the battery dies in two hours, and I'm done with it. I want a refund, now.
I'm very sorry to hear you're experiencing issues with your VeloBand Pulse. I can certainly look into this for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device?
What did I just say? It's a fault! The thing is garbage! I don't have time for a million questions and I definitely don't have time to troubleshoot. I just want my money back.
I understand your frustration, and I hear you. You don't want to troubleshoot; you just want a resolution. Let me pull up your account and our return policy to see what we can do.

You better be able to do something. If I have to waste my afternoon on this, I'm going to light up your reviews page. I'm a VIP member, you know. Is this how you treat your best customers? Get me your manager!

There's no need for that, sir, I assure you I can help. I see your VIP status here, and we truly appreciate your business. Please give me just one moment to check the policy for your order... Okay, I have it here.
It looks like you received the item 32 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for a full refund.
Well, finally. That's what you should have said from the start. A full refund?

Yes, a full refund. And for the trouble this has caused, and as a thank you for being a loyal VIP member, I'd also like to add a $50 credit to your VeloFit account for a future purchase. I sincerely apologize that the Pulse band didn't work out for you.
Fine. A full refund and a $50 credit. That's acceptable. Email me the return label.

Of course. I've just sent that prepaid shipping label to the email on file. The $50 credit is already active on your account. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued. Can I assist you with anything else today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
